comment: Per-feed data mode: live | fixture | synthetic. Synthetic values are always badged 'emulated' in evidence and UI.

warnings_fr.note: official data.gouv BMS mirror, synced daily (~24h max lag, disclosed in coverage_note)

warnings_uk.note: Met Office shipping-forecast print page (no API exists); gale warnings between issues invisible until next forecast

warnings_us.note: NWS api.weather.gov active alerts per marine zone (official structured API); merged for routes with us_zones

warnings_meteoalarm.note: Meteoalarm CAP JSON per country (national services aggregated); coastal zones only — high-seas bulletins not distributed via Meteoalarm; merged for routes with meteoalarm_zones

warnings_au.note: BOM marine wind warning summary XML per state via anonymous FTP (structured hazards, UTC validity); coastal waters zones only — BOM high-seas products not fetched; merged for routes with au_zones

tides.note: per route: NOAA CO-OPS official predictions (US), MSQ official predictions on data.qld.gov.au (QLD), or CMEMS 15-min model SSH (IBI Channel, Med); degrades to synthetic harmonics on fetch failure

observations.note: per route: NDBC realtime2 (GTS/C-MAN), Copernicus In Situ TAC NRT moorings (Med), or QLD Coastal Data System wave buoys (AU, waves only); recent past only — future windows report not_independently_observed
